param_input_item.param_description: Field size: a scalar for a square field, or a [rows cols] vector.
Maximum iteration count (default varies per fractal). Higher values resolve finer filaments.
Complex plane window [xmin xmax ymin ymax].

param_output_item.param_description: Smooth (fractional) escape-iteration count; 0 marks points inside the set.

description.p: Render the Mandelbrot set with smooth (continuous) escape-time coloring. For every pixel c the iteration z <- z^2 + c is run from z = 0; the fractional escape count gives band-free shading. maxiter defaults to 100 and region to [-2.5 1 -1.25 1.25].

xmldoc.bibliography: M. Hendrikx, S. Meijer, J. van der Velden, A. Iosup, Procedural Content Generation for Games: A Survey, ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications 9(1), 2013. DOI 10.1145/2422956.2422957.

example_item.example_item_data: R = tessera.mandelbrot(800, 300); imagesc(R); axis image off; colormap(tessera.colormap('fire'))
